text:
maya: FYI Velora Health returned the vendor questionnaire. Main asks: embeddings retention window, BYOK availability across deployments, and whether SOC2 evidence can be shared with their auditors. Need quick answers to include in renewal package by EOD.

ev an-cs: i'll grab the customer-facing bullets. quick recap from product: default embeddings retention = 90 days; customers can request deletion earlier. storage is per-tenant, encrypted at rest.

sara-ops: addendum for retention: for Dedicated and Private customers we can offer configurable retention in the contract (e.g., 30/90/365 days) if they need. Ops requires the requested retention set during provisioning.

maya: good. evan can you draft a one-line answer + a link to our retention playbook?

ev an-cs: draft: "Redwood retains customer-generated embeddings for up to 90 days by default. Customers may request earlier deletion via API or account rep; contractual retention terms can be set for Dedicated or Private deployments. See https://internal.redwood/docs/privacy/embeddings-retention for details."

jamie-legal: for SOC2: we can provide our SOC2 Type II report under NDA. Proposed short answer: "SOC2 Type II report is available under NDA; customers requiring auditor access should coordinate via their account team to initiate evidence sharing." Keep it high level.

maya: perfect. also Velora asked if BYOK is available for hosted. short answer: hosted = limited (bring-your-own-key for restricted tenants via cloud provider integrations on request, requires scoping). Dedicated = full BYOK integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Private = yes (customer-managed HSM/KMS).

sara-ops: i'll paste a small ops snippet for Dedicated onboarding: ```
1. Customer provides KMS key identifier (ARN or resource ID)
2. CS opens provisioning ticket tagging ops with customer id
3. Ops configures key binding and verifies access
4. Rotation policy confirmed with customer
```

ev an-cs: add a one-liner for the form: "BYOK available on Dedicated and Private; hosted BYOK reviewed per-case. Contact your account team for details."

jamie-legal: minor legal tweak: replace "BYOK available" with "BYOK supported" to avoid implying SLAs. Also add: "Evidence sharing subject to NDA and scope."

ev an-cs: updated both lines in the doc.

docbot: Created doc https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/velora-1729990000 (view-only).

maya: thanks team. i'll assemble into the renewal package and propose a pilot Dedicated pool to address residency+pricing concerns. can someone join a quick call tomorrow at 10am PT to walk Velora infra? sara-ops: can you?

sara-ops: yes, I'll join.

maya: great. jamie-legal 12 any blockers to sending answers now?

jamie-legal: none. send but leave a note that deeper auditor requests will go via account escalation and NDA.

docbot: Shared doc updated: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/velora-1729990000 (updated by evan-cs).

maya: Sent the form back to Velora. closing thread; follow-ups tracked in the doc. :rocket:
